note: IDs are stable; gates and tests reference them. 'spec' cites the design section. 'firstGate' names the earliest phase gate that must prove the requirement.

requirements.title: Per-client adaptation: each client resolves/renders its own UI from its viewport, safe areas, accessibility, bindings, presentation state
Server-authoritative semantics: server owns/validates gameplay state; replicates semantic state, never layout or device presentation
No component rerun for non-structural updates
Explicit structural reactivity: only declared regions (When/ForEach) mount/move/unmount nodes; duplicate keys are hard errors
Glitch-free transactions: no partially propagated dependency graph observable; scheduler phases ordered; cycles diagnosed; errors quarantined
Pure layout: measure/arrange on immutable snapshots; no live signals, Instances, or yielding APIs in the solver
V1 sizing algebra + containers with diagnostics for undefined/cyclic combinations
Text premeasurement: non-yielding provider with ready/pending/failed, engine queue, conservative fallback, cache keys
Explicit ownership: one owner per framework resource; own/use/child; reverse-order idempotent cleanup; double-disposal detected
Memory/registry neutrality: mount/unmount and churn return every tracked registry to baseline
Action-first input via InputContext/InputAction/InputBinding; no control binds hardware key codes; UserInputService only behind platform adapter
Hybrid-device behavior: PreferredInput changes hints/emphasis only; all available inputs keep working; no remount
requirements.note: deferred from phase-0 by ADR-0004 (no mounted renderer to prove no-remount against)

requirements.title: Split test harness (ADR-0004): scriptable bindings validate the binding-to-action pipeline; cross-context priority/sinking validated with real or injected key events at engine gates; no direct callback bypass
InputContext priority/sink/lifetime correct; context disposal disconnects and disables everything it owns
Logical focus graph owned by Facet; engine selection is a render output; modal trap and previous-focus restoration
Replication contract: monotonic revisions; stale/dup ignored; gap triggers resnapshot; reconnect converges
Typed mutations: request ID, validation, idempotent confirm/reject; optimistic state reconciles; pending never implies success
Server/shared modules cannot require the client renderer; client-only execution boundary enforced and tested
One property authority per engine render property (layout/style/binding/presentation/custom host); conflicts are debug errors
Environment: per-key observable facts; subscribers invalidate only on their keys; presenter owns inset policy; TopbarInset is dynamic geometry
Headless diagnostics: deterministic machine-readable dumps (versioned schema) for layout, lifecycle, interaction, state failures
Engine authority: headless checks screen; Studio/device differential fixtures within declared tolerances are authoritative
Performance: instrumented hot paths; benchmark method reproducible; floor-device budget documented and enforced at release gates
Escape hatch: UI.Custom mounts raw Instances under explicit contract (rects, tokens, owned properties, disposal, diagnostics)
Agent autonomy: stable commands exit nonzero on failure, write structured artifacts, name failing requirement, actionable hint

Structural affordances per live class: every interactive control exposes each live class's structural idiom (pointer direct-drag/hover/wheel; touch 44px/naked-pan-scroll/edit-grip; keyboard focus+Navigate/Activate/Adjust; gamepad focus+grab/A-B/Adjust), derived from interactionClasses' live set — never preferredInput alone — with zero consumer wiring

Hot-switch transition semantics: every in-flight interaction state (drag/capture, pan, edit-mode, grab-mode, focus, text entry) has a defined CARRY or CANCEL outcome per class-flip; a flip never wedges an interaction and never loses uncommitted data

Ten-foot presentation: distanceProfile ten-foot (displaySize Large) applies the type-scale floor, overscan margins, reduced density, and strengthened focus visibility; Navigate tolerates Thumbstick1 alongside DPad*

Native scroll/clip substrate: scroll regions are native ScrollingFrame hosts; the solver keeps owning content geometry and contentSize; the engine owns scroll physics, clipping, and scroll bars; programmatic keep-visible writes CanvasPosition

Native drag acquisition: UIDragDetector behind an adapter capability; Facet keeps the pure drag-session model (payload, legal targets, enter/leave, cancellation) with a headless driver and a fallback path exercised separately

Native touch gestures: GuiObject touch events normalized into stable framework value objects; composition/arbitration decisions stay headless; no raw-sample re-recognition unless a native event is proven insufficient
Native paths: a Path adapter backed by Path2D for strokes/arcs/radial progress; bespoke constructions retained only where a concrete requirement failed with evidence
Safe-area singularity: four-edge insets read from the modern GuiService inset surface; deviceSafeInsets populated; exactly one inset authority applies (never solver facts plus engine insets together)

Preferred text applied exactly once: the engine owns the player's preference in paint; Facet applies only authored scale; headless measurement reserves matching bounds from injected facts; measure and paint never diverge or clip

Selection policy: passive/gameplay targets keep GuiService.SelectedObject nil; an engine-selection bridge is opt-in for an engaged modal/menu only, reversible, clears on teardown, and requires physical-gamepad proof before being contract

Honest resource transport: ContentProvider:PreloadAsync fulfils the provider's pending requests; releasing a handle ignores stale completion and prevents queued-unstarted work; no in-flight cancellation is claimed

Evidence-classed performance: every record names the instrument that produced it (lune | studio-emulated | desktop-retail | phone-physical | console-physical) and its evidence level; budgets derive from a measured baseline and a supported frame target; a device budget is never enforced from a non-device class

Future spatial seam: presentation-space and spatial-pointing facts, optional ray/3D-hit/pose/handedness/phase/target on normalized events, and a declared future world render target — contracts only; no VR support claim without the named physical focus/hover/occlusion/comfort/cancellation/performance gate

Interruptible value-motion authority: named motion classes (damping/response), re-target any frame from current value+velocity, velocity seeding, live-readable targets re-read per frame, perceptual arrival + settle events, injectable clock for headless determinism, zero cost at rest; writes presentation-channel properties only (never solver geometry or native-sheet paint)

requirements.title: Structural enter/exit transitions: When/ForEach branches and presented surfaces animate in/out interruptibly with a hard completion cap; disposal completes exactly once; re-entry mid-exit reverses; leak-free under churn

Reduced-motion information parity: every motion/transition/transient contract has an RM equivalent (instant placement or short fade) that preserves the full information surface and emits the same semantic events; informational timers still deplete; nothing is silently dropped

requirements.title: Unified collection substrate: one public list construct that windows, selects, reorders, and acts as a drop surface simultaneously, with stable row identity, selection, and focus across live order churn

Public drag/drop contract: blueprint-level draggable payload sources and drop targets over the pure drag session (payload, game-supplied legality, exactly-once enter/leave, predicted verdict, cancel, reject-with-reason snap-back), cross-container, with a non-pointer arm/navigate/commit paradigm through the same session and no second policy path

Gesture velocity handoff and promotion tokens: rolling-window release velocity seeds the settle motion (zero seed on non-gestural cancels via the same path); press-to-drag promotion thresholds are shared per-input-class tokens; release under threshold stays a tap

Drag-to-edge autoscroll: pointer-band membership with dwell arming, penetration-proportional speed with start ramp and exit ease, frame-accurate hover re-resolution during scroll, canvas-end clamp that stays armed, inert on short content; framework defaults within the ratified ranges, tunable per host

requirements.title: Authored paint extensions under single property authority: continuous per-node color binding for values a selector cannot express, Image tint/scale-mode, a public reactive stroke modifier, a deterministic zIndex paint-order override, and fractional Anchor offsets for keyed live marker overlays — each with declared authority and no native-sheet conflict

Transient toast presentation: input-transparent, self-retiring, stacked surfaces above the base screen that never steal focus or block gameplay input, scheduled with priority, queue cap, per-item minimum dwell, and same-subject supersede

Semantic interaction events: controls, drag sessions, and motion arrivals emit named events on their causal frames through one subscribe seam; Facet never plays sound or haptics; events carry source and reason context

Async image completeness: failure is a silent presentable state (placeholder persists, no error glyph), bounded-retry option with session give-up, preload seam for declared imminent identity sets, stale rejection under recycle/churn, and a live-session transport proof
